emotional_progression: curiosity (s1) -> determination (s2) -> wonder (s3) -> focus (s4) -> urgency (s5) -> quiet joy (s6)
narrative_structure: Establish (Mara, the mapmaker, the compass) -> departure (the compass points somewhere new) -> wonder (a world drawn becomes real) -> discovery (the map redraws itself) -> pursuit (running toward the garden) -> resolution (the garden from the stories).
note: The visible character (Mara, DEMO-CHAR-001) is project-local and is NOT carried in character_resolutions: the P1-006 project model resolves registry identities only through an explicit identity policy, and this demonstration character is deliberately never registered in the global character registry. Her binding lives in character-bible.json and in every shot record of shot-list.json, validated by runtime/character_consistency.py.

pacing.beats_per_minute: measured from real narration durations at assembly time

premise: A short vertical animated story: Mara, a young mapmaker, follows her grandmother's brass compass to a hidden garden — the same character, recognizably herself, in six distinct scenes.

scenes.description: Establishing: Mara in her attic map studio at morning light; the compass begins to point somewhere new.
Medium action: Mara walks the old forest path, map in hand, compass glowing.
Close-up: Mara's face in wonder as the drawn world becomes real.
Side/three-quarter: Mara crouches by a stream, tracing the redrawn map.
Movement: Mara runs across the wildflower meadow toward the stone arch.
Closing: Mara stands in the hidden garden at golden hour, smiling, compass raised.

shot_direction.direction: Attic studio, morning window light, maps everywhere; Mara at the table, compass in hand.
Forest path, dappled light, map in hand, compass glowing faintly.
Close-up on Mara's face; wonder; compass light reflected; soft forest bokeh behind.
Three-quarter view; Mara crouching by a stream, finger tracing the map.
Meadow run toward a stone arch; hair and jacket in motion; wide vertical framing.
Hidden walled garden at golden hour; Mara smiling, compass raised; flowers around.
